name: Omaherd
author: Salem Sayed
description: A local and remote HerdR attention inbox for the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: See every HerdR agent, what it is doing, and who is waiting on you — local and remote — and jump straight to the pane.

schema.label: Group agents by
schema.description: Attention lists whoever needs you first across every host. Host keeps each machine's agents together. G in the panel flips this.

schema.label: Show the herd in the bar
schema.description: Draw one dot per active agent beside the sheep — working or needing you — so the herd is readable without opening the panel. Quiet agents add nothing.

schema.label: Instant updates
schema.description: Link Omaherd's HerdR hook (herdr plugin link) so a local agent's state change reaches the bar at once instead of on the next poll. Turning this off does not unlink; run `herdr plugin unlink io.github.salemsayed.omaherd`.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often Omaherd refreshes local and remote agent state.

schema.label: Monitored remote hosts
schema.description: Hosts Omaherd monitors in the background. Clicking Monitor adds discovered hosts here automatically.

schema.label: Hidden hosts
schema.description: Discovered hosts Omaherd should stop offering. X on a host in the panel adds it here.

schema.label: SSH timeout (seconds)
schema.description: Connection timeout for background checks of remote HerdR hosts.

schema.label: Notify when an agent
schema.description: One toast per agent, replaced as its state changes and withdrawn once it stops waiting. Clicking a toast brings the agent to the front.

schema.label: Peek and reply from the panel
schema.description: Lets P show an agent's last terminal lines and I type a reply into its pane. Off by default: this is the only feature that reads pane output, and only when you ask.
